_README.description: Mistral via la Plateforme OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, MISTRAL_API_KEY).
_README.aa_version: AA Intelligence Index v5.0.1 (leaderboard read 2026-11-10, checked again 2026-11-11), the values of the mistralai/* OpenRouter entries for the same models. The scores follow the v5.0.1 ladder in docs/model_ranking.md. Change this line at each AA regrade.
_README.usage: Base URL https://api.mistral.ai/v1. Mixed open/closed lineup. The model names are the versioned API names from Mistral's model docs (read 2026-11-21); the old `*-latest` names are aliases, because Mistral moves them to new releases without notice. Scores and AA values are pinned to the mistralai/* OpenRouter entries for the same models. Verify model IDs against /models if a call 404s.

models.description: Mistral Large 4 (v26.10) - flagship model for reasoning, coding and agentic work (1M context). Direct la Plateforme API. AA Intelligence Index v5 26 at high (23 at medium; read 2026-11-10), from the mistralai/mistral-large-4-0 OpenRouter entry. The old name mistral-large-latest is an alias.

Mistral Small 4 (v26.03) - fast, low-cost Apache-2.0 model. Direct la Plateforme API. AA Intelligence Index v5 4 (one row, read 2026-11-10), from the mistralai/mistral-small-2603 OpenRouter entry. The old name mistral-small-latest is an alias.
